text: dsh-starter-zh 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 新手的中文入门插件，通过注册 starter_zh 工具和可选的 systemPrompt 引导，在会话中提供欢迎语、五阶段学习路径、按场景推荐插件及自查清单。用户可按 welcome、path、plugins、checklist 动作获取对应文本和条目，路径涵盖启动、profile、安装、编写和发布插件。适合刚开始使用 DSH 或学习制作插件的人；配置可调整提示词排序、开关和教程链接，无需额外密钥。

dsh-starter-zh helps Chinese-speaking DSH beginners with a welcome, five-stage learning path, scenario-based plugin suggestions, and self-check list through the starter_zh tool. An optional systemPrompt guide points beginners to it. No API key is configured.
想让 DSH 新手有一份从启动到发布插件的中文学习路线。
刚装好 DeepSeek Harness，不知道该先学 profile 还是先装插件，能给我带路吗？
希望在 DSH 会话里按使用场景找到适合新手的插件，并逐项检查入门进度。
dsh-starter-zh 的功能「新手入门工具」：在 DSH 会话调用 starter_zh，选择 welcome、path、plugins 或 checklist，即可查看欢迎引导、学习路径、场景插件推荐或自查清单。
dsh-starter-zh 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 62 天；提交数 12；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

text:
dsh-starter-zh README · What you get：| Feature | Tool / Section | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Welcome | `starter_zh` action=`welcome` | Greeting + what you can do next |
| Learning path | `starter_zh` action=`path` | 0→1 in 5 stages: run → profile → install → write → publish |
| Recommended plugins | `starter_zh` action=`plugins` | Scenario groups (start here / focus & memory / security / productivity) |
| Self-check | `starter_zh` action=`checklist` | 10-item onboarding checklist |
| Guidance prompt | `systemPrompt` section | Tells the model to use `starter_zh` when the user is a beginner |

dsh-starter-zh README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-starter-zh
```

Then ask your agent: "我是 DSH 新手，带我入门" — it will call `starter_zh` automatically.

dsh-starter-zh README · Config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sectionOrder` | 10 | Prompt section order |
| `promptEnabled` | true | Inject the guidance prompt section |
| `handbookUrl` | dsh-handbook-zh repo | Companion tutorial URL in the welcome text |

dsh-starter-zh README · Why this plugin：The DSH ecosystem exploded to thousands of plugins in 72 hours, but there is no systematic Chinese onboarding path. This starter pack fills that gap — it is the "from 0 to 1" entry point, backed by a full Chinese handbook repo.

dsh-starter-zh README · Docs：- [USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md) — model-side usage, tool parameters, config
- [RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md) — release checklist

dsh-starter-zh README · Development：```bash
node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/starter.js
node test/starter.test.mjs
node scripts/verify.mjs
```

Pure logic lives in `lib/starter.js` (zero deps, unit-tested); the Cordis plugin in `lib/index.js` registers the `starter_zh` tool and the prompt section.
